    line = max(set(x for row in g for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in g for v in row))
    rs = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == line for v in g[r])]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == line for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + rs + [h]

        rowtiles = []
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):

            rowtiles.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
        tiles.append(rowtiles)

    # Repeat a tile pattern into an empty neighboring tile, reflected vertically

    for i in range(len(tiles)-1):

    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    sep = 8 if 8 in g[0] else max(set(x for row in g for x in row if x),
                                  key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in g for v in row))

    cs = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rs + [h], [-1] + cs + [w]
    tiles = [[(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1], cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])
              for j in range(len(cb)-1)] for i in range(len(rb)-1)]

    def points(t):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = t
        return [(r-r0, c-c0, g[r][c]) for r in range(r0, r1)
                for c in range(c0, c1) if g[r][c] not in (0, sep)]

    # Matching cell motifs are repeated as reflections across the separator.
    for i in range(len(tiles)-1):
        for j in range(len(tiles[i])):
            a, b = tiles[i][j], tiles[i+1][j]
            pa, pb = points(a), points(b)
            if bool(pa) == bool(pb):
                continue
            src, dst = (a, b) if pa else (b, a)
            sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = src
            dr0, dr1, dc0, dc1 = dst

                rr = dr0 + (sr1-sr0-1-r)
                cc = dc0 + c
                if rr < dr1 and cc < dc1:
                    g[rr][cc] = color

    for row in tiles:
        for j in range(len(row)-1):
            a, b = row[j], row[j+1]
            pa, pb = points(a), points(b)

                rr = dr0 + r

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])

    # Identify the grid separator color and its full separator rows/columns.
    sep = max((v for row in g for v in row if v != 0),
              key=lambda c: sum(x == c for row in g for x in row))
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in g[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rows + [h], [-1] + cols + [w]
    tiles = [[(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1], cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1])
              for j in range(len(cb) - 1)] for i in range(len(rb) - 1)]

    def motif(tile):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = tile
        return [(r - r0, c - c0, g[r][c])
                for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)
                if g[r][c] not in (0, sep)]

    # Each neighboring tile pair forms a horizontally reflected motif pair.
    for row in tiles:
        for j in range(0, len(row) - 1, 2):
            left, right = row[j], row[j + 1]
            lm, rm = motif(left), motif(right)
            if bool(lm) == bool(rm):
                continue
            src, dst = (left, right) if lm else (right, left)
            sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = src
            dr0, dr1, dc0, dc1 = dst
            for r, c, color in motif(src):
                rr = dr0 + r
                cc = dc0 + (sc1 - sc0 - 1 - c)
                if rr < dr1 and cc < dc1:
                    g[rr][cc] = color

    return g
